## Summary

Describe the user-visible problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and any platform or paid RunPod path you could not exercise.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change stays within mintPod's single-session coding-model scope.
- [ ] Paid mutations retain durable ownership and cleanup behavior.
- [ ] Existing Pi/OpenCode configuration is preserved and Aider remains command-only.
- [ ] No credentials, resource IDs, private configuration, or unsafe diagnostics are included.
- [ ] Frontend checks/build, Rust format/lint/tests, and runtime tests pass where applicable.
- [ ] User-visible behavior and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated when needed.
